
DESCRIPTION
Forward commands to the upstream Skills CLI

USAGE
  one skills [args...] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one skills find react
  one skills add owner/repo --skill skill-name
  one skills list
  one skills update

TIPS
Run npx skills@1.7.0 with all arguments unchanged in the current directory.
One prepares Node when it is missing and preserves upstream interaction, output,
and exit codes. Use one skills --help for upstream help.

Business skills are installed only on request from their GitHub repositories.
One does not add --global, --agent, or the Skills CLI --yes flag to manual commands.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
